module: Node "Color HSV" (simple category). Creates a color from hue, saturation, value (0 to 1) and alpha. Output: color = table {r, g, b, a}. Default values if the input is empty: h=0, s=1, v=1, a=1.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

HSVtoRGB.desc: Converts HSV to a {r, g, b} table via the global function HSVtoRGB; the hue is brought into [0,1[ and s, v are clamped to [0,1].

work.desc: Computes the color and writes {r, g, b, alpha} to color.
